title: Decompression bomb protection
description: Engineering consequence of HCERT Specification, 6.3 Input Data Validation.

statements.label: Decompression bomb protection
statements.requirement: Inflation SHALL stop with a typed error once the output exceeds a configurable limit (DecodeLimits.maxInflatedBytes).

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-ZIP-002 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-ZIP-002 a decompression bomb stops at the limit` (CompressTest.kt)).
